rationale: Build on the current reverse-tail recurrent baseline with a minimal structural change: add zero-init learned tail_anchor_gates so each recurrent tail block can gently refresh the shared decoder-output anchor toward its updated state. This keeps compile shape stable, preserves near-baseline behavior at initialization, adds only tiny control tensors that already stay in float for export, and directly targets the still-promising reverse-tail anchor variant category without repeating another pure scalar sweep or risky float-budget rewrite.
title: Gated Reverse-Tail Anchor Refresh
